notes: Simu iliyofungwa ambayo bado ni stoo (haijauzwa) inapata dakika zake zote za matumizi baada ya kuwashwa upya, hata ikiwa mtandaoni — awali ilifungwa sekunde ya kwanza ilipomfikia ofisi. Simu iliyouzwa haibadiliki. / A locked phone that is still stock (unsold) keeps its full boot window after a restart, even when online — it used to lock in the first second, the moment it reached the office.
